verdict.rationale: Obsidian's mobile page says the app includes tabs, the Command Palette and plugins, and the help docs describe a customizable mobile editing toolbar, which suggests a full app rather than a stripped-down companion. A community report notes that the Android app delays writing files to storage until the note unloads, which can drop the last lines when syncing mid-edit. missing for 10: explicit evidence of search and internal linking on mobile, detailed mobile feature-parity documentation, independent hands-on corroboration of mobile depth.
